title: 第1809章 天盟第1808章 身不由己
slug: 穿书女频大婚当日被女主杀死
content_zh:
“没啥问题！”
众人轻轻点头，觉得没啥问题。
一个联盟、四大护法、七座大殿，平日里七座大殿负责各大道统的事情，到时候让那些道统的强者都入七殿就行。
现在就是盟主之位的事情，这个位子，自然是叶凌天和凤惑君的。
叶凌天继续道：“现在是盟主的事情，我和凤惑厚着脸当盟主，大凰和雪漓当副盟主；另外第七殿，可名为天殿，此殿只管杀伐，由叶无涯掌控，曦晨、帝央、唐若愚等人皆处第七殿。”
第七殿，管杀伐之事，主要提升修为，与仙族厮杀，不收纳其余道统之人，不会为其余的事情分心，让叶无涯等人处在其中，倒是很有必要。
“可行！”
原始道祖、永恒帝尊、光阴之主和商无终四人笑着点头。
叶凌天道：“这个联盟道统，属于暂时建立，若是到时候解决了仙族，大家可自由离去。”
建立道统的目的，可不是为了统治他人，眼下只是为了抵抗强敌，若是解决了强敌，他日有人想离去，自然没问题。
还是那句话，对他而言，这个道统是否建立，其实都差不多，因为他一人便是一个无敌的道统。
“问题不大。”
众人哑然一笑。
叶凌天见众人没有异议之后，他看向曦晨：“曦晨，让那些道统之人进入太阳神城吧！”
“好！”
曦晨轻轻挥手，一道力量涌入九阳神城，她的声音在九阳神城响起：“各位道友，入太阳神城一叙。”
俄顷！
太阳神城闪过三千多道光芒，两千多位道主、六百位道祖出现。
“永恒帝尊。”
“光阴之主。”

“原始道祖。”
“魔祖无终。”
“东皇太一。”
“......”
这些道统强者看到永恒帝尊等人的时候，他们身躯一震，眼中露出惊奇之色。
今日这么多强者前来吗？竟然连光阴之主都出现了。
而且本该覆灭的原始道祖等人，竟然还活着，实在是诡异，让人感到震撼。
叶凌天身影一动，他看向前来之人，开口道：“之前曦晨已经给各位说过建立道统联盟的事情，各位可有什么想法？”
众人纷纷抱拳：“没有任何问题，我等愿意成为联盟道统的一员。”
单单一个永恒帝庭与太阳神州建立联盟，便可让他们趋之若鹜，想要与太阳神州建立联盟关系。
现在这里又多了几位强者，连光阴之主都来了，他们更不会拒绝联盟之事。
叶凌天见状，他轻轻点头：“既然如此，我便说一下这个联盟的事情，此联盟就叫天盟，其大本营就位居太阳神城。我和凤君为盟主，澹台凰和沐雪漓为副盟主，天盟之中有四位护法，由原始道祖、永恒帝尊、光阴之主、无终魔族担任护法之位。”
“天盟内再设七殿，分别是天殿、金乌殿、祖魔殿、火神殿、轩辕殿、神农殿、伏羲殿。”
“此七殿由叶无涯、东皇太一、计都、老火皇、轩辕、神农、伏羲掌控，除了天殿外，八百神州的各大道统强者，可入其余六殿，若有事情，直接找六殿之主。”
content_en:
"No problem!"
Everyone nodded slightly, thinking there was no problem.
There is an alliance, four guardians, and seven halls. Normally, the seven halls are responsible for the affairs of each lineage. When the time comes, all the strong men of the lineage can be allowed to enter the seven halls.
Now it's a matter of the position of alliance leader. This position naturally belongs to Ye Lingtian and Feng Huojun.
Ye Lingtian continued: "Now it's a matter of alliance leaders. Feng Huo and I will shamelessly be alliance leaders, Dahuang and Xueli will be deputy alliance leaders; the seventh palace can be called the Heaven Palace. This palace is only responsible for killing and is controlled by Ye Wuya. Xichen, Di Yang, Tang Ruoyu and others are all in the seventh palace."
The Seventh Hall is in charge of killings. It mainly improves cultivation and fights with the immortal clan. It does not accept people from other orthodox traditions and will not be distracted by other things. It is necessary for Ye Wuya and others to be in it.
"It works!"
The original Dao Ancestor, the Eternal Emperor, the Lord of Time and Shang Wuzhong smiled and nodded.
Ye Lingtian said: "This alliance is temporarily established. If the immortal clan is eliminated by then, everyone can leave freely."
The purpose of establishing an orthodoxy is not to rule others. It is just to resist strong enemies at the moment. If the strong enemies are defeated, if some people want to leave in the future, it will be no problem.
Again, for him, it doesn't matter whether the orthodoxy is established or not, because he alone is an invincible orthodoxy.
"It's not a big problem."
Everyone laughed dumbly.
After Ye Lingtian saw that everyone had no objections, he looked at Xichen: "Xichen, let those orthodox people enter the City of the Sun God!"
"Okay!"
Xichen waved her hand gently, and a wave of power surged into Jiuyang Divine City. Her voice rang in Jiuyang Divine City: "Fellow Taoists, please enter the Sun Divine City for a brief introduction."
A moment!
More than three thousand rays of light flashed through the City of the Sun God, and more than two thousand Tao masters and six hundred Tao ancestors appeared.
"Eternal Emperor."
"The Lord of Time."
"Original Taoist Ancestor."
"The Demon Ancestor has no end."
"Donghuang Taiyi."
"..."
When these Taoist powerhouses saw the Eternal Emperor and others, their bodies trembled, and their eyes showed surprise.
Are there so many powerful people coming today? Even the Lord of Time appeared.
Moreover, the original Taoist ancestors and others who were supposed to be destroyed are still alive, which is really weird and shocking.
Ye Lingtian's figure moved. He looked at the people coming and said, "Xi Chen has told you about the establishment of the Taoist Alliance before. What do you think?"
Everyone clasped their fists: "No problem, we are willing to become a member of the alliance's orthodoxy."
Just the establishment of an alliance between the Eternal Imperial Court and the Sun State can make them flock to it and want to establish an alliance with the Sun State.
Now there are several more powerful people here, even the Lord of Time is here, and they will not refuse the alliance.
Seeing this, Ye Lingtian nodded slightly: "In that case, let me tell you something about this alliance. This alliance is called the Tianmeng, and its headquarters is located in the City of the Sun God. Fengjun and I are the leaders of the alliance, and Tantaihuang and Mu Xueli are the deputy leaders. There are four guardians in the Tianliang, including the Original Dao Ancestor, the Eternal Emperor, the Lord of Time, and the Endless Demon Clan."
"There are seven more halls in the Tianmeng, namely the Heavenly Palace, the Golden Crow Palace, the Ancestral Demon Palace, the Fire Palace, the Xuanyuan Palace, the Shennong Palace, and the Fuxi Palace."
"These seven halls are controlled by Ye Wuya, Donghuang Taiyi, Jidu, Old Fire Emperor, Xuanyuan, Shennong, and Fuxi. In addition to the Heavenly Palace, the powerful masters of the eight hundred divine states can enter the other six halls. If anything happens, please go directly to the master of the six halls."
